name: syllabus-accounts
description: Accounts for Syllabus: Google sign-in, device claims, settings and Drive grants.

scripts.escalation: wrangler d1 execute syllabus-accounts --remote --command "SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(escalated) AS escalated, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(escalated) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_escalated, SUM(turns) AS turns FROM assist_sessions GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC"
scripts.split: wrangler d1 execute syllabus-accounts --remote --command "SELECT period, provider, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(units) AS seconds, ROUND(SUM(units)/3600.0, 2) AS hours FROM usage WHERE kind = 'transcribe' AND state = 'final' GROUP BY period, provider ORDER BY period DESC, seconds DESC"
